messages: Take a deep breath. This craving will pass in just a few minutes, like a wave.
Remember why you started. You have already overcome much harder moments.
This is just a temporary urge. Hold on for 3 short minutes.
Every craving you resist reinforces your freedom. You are stronger than this habit.
Take this moment for yourself, calm and clear. You do not need this cigarette.
challenges: Drink a tall glass of cold water slowly and take 5 deep breaths.
Listen to your favorite song with your eyes closed all the way to the end.
Do some gentle shoulder and neck stretches while focusing on your breath.
Splash cold water on your face to create an immediate physical reset.
Send a kind text message to a friend to occupy your hands and mind.
